review_method_zh: 阅读每个编号标题下的直接正文；中文分析为项目解释，英文原文保持独立。图表读取原图/HTML单元格；图中文字、连线与正文矛盾另记。

concepts_zh: 本卷说明不同风格、迭代、全景层级与分区应用。
applicability_zh: 将通用ADM用于具体组织和问题。
logic_zh: 应用规则调整范围、描述和治理连接。
decisions_zh: 结合后续四章选择方法配置。
artifacts_evidence_zh: ADM应用约定及裁剪理由。
limits_zh: 章节标题不另立固定流程。

sections.title_en: 1.1. Using the TOGAF Framework with Different Architecture Styles
concepts_zh: 风格在焦点、形式、技术、材料、主题和时间方面有独特特征。
applicability_zh: 全景中可同时存在不同风格。
logic_zh: 先识别特征，再调整模型、视点、工具及必要元模型扩展；主导风格可触发预备阶段能力调整。
decisions_zh: B/C/D选择能回应关切的资源，检验对其他利益相关者及基线的影响。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 风格特征清单、视点、元模型扩展与能力变更。
limits_zh: 通常不需大改TOGAF；外部风格资料是引用而非本六卷已收齐来源。

concepts_zh: 迭代是管理架构复杂性及生命周期的实际应用方式。
applicability_zh: 描述顺序可能被误读为瀑布时。
logic_zh: 多轮完整ADM、同一轮跨阶段和能力自身演进是不同迭代维度。
decisions_zh: 按架构目标设计回返和检查点。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 迭代计划与输入输出依赖。
limits_zh: 不把示意圆环解释成唯一执行日程。

concepts_zh: 多项目构建全景、同周期跨阶段综合、架构能力更新是三种迭代概念。
applicability_zh: 每轮工作受架构工作请求范围约束，项目可并行且相互触发。
logic_zh: 基线目标和B/C/D/E/F活动互相反馈；A或H的能力需求可回到预备阶段。
decisions_zh: 区分工作范围改变与能力更新，必要时启动独立项目。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 请求范围、全景更新、阶段回返及能力变化记录。
limits_zh: 迭代不取消项目启动或全景治理。

concepts_zh: 能力、开发、过渡规划、治理四类迭代聚合相关活动。
applicability_zh: 依架构工作目的组织活动。
logic_zh: 开发迭代综合B/C/D并扩展E/F检查可实施性；规划形成路线图；治理管理目标方向的变更。
decisions_zh: 选择聚焦活动并决定必要扩展。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 能力配置、架构内容、路线图和治理记录。
limits_zh: 图外侧圈表示活动焦点，不是每圈强制单独项目。

concepts_zh: 架构参与可识别所需变革、定义变革、治理实施。
applicability_zh: 支持战略、全景/项目组合、基础性/有界变化和实施治理。
logic_zh: 6类参与各有不同焦点、迭代与范围；基础性变革需澄清问题，有界变革已有愿景范围。
decisions_zh: 按问题是否已理解及组织层级选参与类型。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 参与声明、范围、对应产物及迭代配置。
limits_zh: 组合治理的架构维度补充服务/项目管理，不替代其权限。

concepts_zh: 可选择基线优先或目标优先。
applicability_zh: 复杂不明/不一致基线适合前者，已有高层目标适合后者。
logic_zh: 两状态仍互相考虑；焦点选择维持执行一致性。
decisions_zh: 基线已广泛理解时通常优先目标，再按差距需要补基线。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 选择理由、基线/目标说明及差距。
limits_zh: 目标优先不允许完全忽略现有依赖。

concepts_zh: 迭代次数、过程及检查点依目的和参与程度设计。
applicability_zh: 部分迭代可一次，部分自然需多次。
logic_zh: 高度参与可频繁非正式检查，低参与可能稀疏正式检查。
decisions_zh: 明确每次迭代目标、退出证据和检查频率。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 迭代检查点、参与及审阅证据。
limits_zh: 原文不给每迭代统一时间盒。

concepts_zh: 单一描述层级的完整ADM周期可由F启动更细架构项目。
applicability_zh: 需要高层约束指导低层并形成全景。
logic_zh: Strategic→Segment→Capability是架构层级关系，各层有独立或并行周期。
decisions_zh: 界定细化工作的独立请求及高层约束。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 多周期工作请求、治理和约束追溯。
limits_zh: 图中叠层只说明多个架构，不能推断确切项目数量。

concepts_zh: 同一周期中的迭代跨多个阶段，Core/Light/Informal表示活动焦点。
applicability_zh: 基线优先或目标优先、多次规划和治理。
logic_zh: 前两轮先一状态再另一状态，后续共同细化；E/F在开发中轻量，在过渡规划中核心。
decisions_zh: 按迭代目的确定活动深度，向前阶段反馈实施问题。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 迭代活动矩阵、可行性/存续性检验和计划修订。
limits_zh: Light、Informal、空白不是完成度、免责或允许忽略适用要求。

concepts_zh: ADM实际迭代方式取决于组织检查点、参与、团队、成熟度、风险文化及参与类型。
applicability_zh: 制定本组织工作计划。
logic_zh: 六因素决定回返、正式性、试验及团队关系。
decisions_zh: 在组织约束内组合本章方法。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 组织因素和选用迭代方式的依据。
limits_zh: 不宣称单次完成总是可行。

sections.title_en: 3. Applying the ADM Across the Architecture Landscape
concepts_zh: 架构全景同时包含具体与概括、详细与宏观的描述。
applicability_zh: 组织并管理多个相关架构。
logic_zh: 层级和架构连续体与存储库及分区关联，但分类维度不同。
decisions_zh: 按利益相关者需求组织可导航全景。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 全景结构与存储库引用。
limits_zh: 本章不提供唯一企业组织模型。

concepts_zh: 层级和连续体帮助管理不同范围和细节的复杂架构。
applicability_zh: 全景内容繁多且用途不同。
logic_zh: 分类框架需映射实际存储内容与架构分区。
decisions_zh: 检验层级分类是否帮助检索、治理与复用。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 全景分类与存储库映射。
limits_zh: 分类架构不等于制定团队权限。

concepts_zh: 战略、分段、能力三层分别支持执行方向、项目组合/计划和能力增量。
applicability_zh: 以粒度划分全景，以抽象度用连续体进一步分类。
logic_zh: 层级与连续体可组合，通用到特定支持派生追溯及消除冗余。
decisions_zh: 按运行模型定义分组、层级、导航、过程和责任。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 三层全景、连续体位置、派生与治理关系。
limits_zh: Capability Architecture不是能力目录里单个能力对象，也不规定唯一分组。

concepts_zh: 宽而概括架构为窄而详细架构设置方向和约束。
applicability_zh: 不同层利益相关者有不同描述需求。
logic_zh: 可在单周期内迭代不同层，或采用并行ADM层级，也可混合。
decisions_zh: 根据工作请求选择混合策略并保持治理层级。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 层间约束及周期关系。
limits_zh: 层级不同不意味独立于上位治理。

concepts_zh: 全景以广度、深度、时间和新近程度组织。
applicability_zh: 理解企业在过去、现状和未来的状态。
logic_zh: 宽范围通常较浅且有效期较长；批准后不维护会随时间失真。
decisions_zh: 区分描述时间、计划有效期和最后维护日期。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 基线/多个目标、范围/粒度、版本与维护记录。
limits_zh: 批准不是永久准确，recency不能等同目标时间。

concepts_zh: 架构分区使复杂性、同时工作及复用可管理。
applicability_zh: 不同组织架构冲突或多团队并行。
logic_zh: 分区奠定治理基础，区别于层级和连续体分类。
decisions_zh: 按运行模型选择分区并定义责任。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 分区目录、范围与治理归属。
limits_zh: 不存在本章规定的唯一分区模型。

concepts_zh: 冲突、团队所有权及模块复用是分区理由。
applicability_zh: 需要不同团队同时处理不同架构部分。
logic_zh: 分类准则帮助界定可管理架构和有效治理。
decisions_zh: 明确要解决的冲突与复用边界。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 分区问题、拥有者和治理原则。
limits_zh: 分区不是只把图切小或按域分文件。

sections.title_en: 4.2. Applying Classification to Create Partitioned Architectures
concepts_zh: 解决方案按主题/时间/成熟波动分类；架构还按深度匹配受众。
applicability_zh: 建立相关解决方案与架构的分组导航。
logic_zh: 真实全景通常不按抽象度分区，波动性限制未来描述与历史准确性。
decisions_zh: 结合主题、生命周期、成熟度和受众选边界。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 分类准则及分区映射。
limits_zh: 本节对全景描述的抽象限制与连续体通用性分类需区分用途。

concepts_zh: 预备阶段建立边界、治理和拥有者，优先每架构一个拥有团队。
applicability_zh: 常设团队与临时变革团队共同工作。
logic_zh: 临时团队置于常设团队治理下；明确团队组织、职责范围与架构间符合/复用关系。
decisions_zh: 先确认治理主体、成员汇报线，再分主题深度时间利益相关者及重叠细化。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 团队责任分区定义、治理汇报和架构关系。
limits_zh: 一个拥有者不禁止跨团队协作；实际组织授权需独立确认。

concepts_zh: 联邦架构需集成框架避免碎片化。
applicability_zh: 大型政府、集团或独立组织单元。
logic_zh: 互操作/迁移/符合原则和标准构建块制品是内容集成约束；跨域、跨组织、愿景到定义/过渡均需整合。
decisions_zh: 将内容集成列为符合条件并复用共同目录与交叉引用。
artifacts_evidence_zh: 集成标准、共用业务过程目录、跨域/分段/过渡追溯。
limits_zh: 共用标识或视图一致性本身不证明业务语义正确。

figures.semantic_review_zh: 四类迭代围绕ADM，Requirements Management居中连接A—H。
figures.labels_connections_zh: 能力圈在Preliminary/A附近；开发圈B/C/D，规划圈E/F，治理圈G/H；外圈为迭代焦点，中心不是Phase I。
limits_zh: 圈线及阶段关联不构成不可回返的日历流程；预备不是A—H中的字母阶段。

figures.semantic_review_zh: 识别、定义和实施变革三块包含6参与类型并以箭头连接。
figures.labels_connections_zh: 战略→全景组合/项目组合；战略→基础性或有界定义；基础性→有界定义；全景组合→有界定义；两类定义→实施治理；项目组合和实施治理之间双向上下文/升级。
limits_zh: 箭头注明业务关系，不能一律改成任务先后或任意审批授权。

figures.caption_en: A Hierarchy of ADM Processes Example
figures.semantic_review_zh: 多个架构层级执行各自ADM，F迁移规划触发更详细项目。
figures.labels_connections_zh: 战略层在右上、分段左侧叠层、能力右下叠层；可见F→下一层A及指向后续叠层边界的曲线。
limits_zh: 叠层端点未指明独立项目ID和多重性，保留为层级项目触发，未逐一命名。

figures.caption_en: Activity by Iteration for Baseline First Architecture Definition
figures.semantic_review_zh: 基线优先的开发迭代在第一轮聚焦四域基线，第二轮聚焦目标。
figures.labels_connections_zh: 基线行开发1/2/n=Core/Light/Core；目标=Informal/Core/Core；E/F开发均Light、规划Core；G/H治理Core；图例Core主、Light次、Informal潜在活动。
limits_zh: 白色空格和Informal分别保存，不能当失败、禁止或不需阶段制品。

figures.caption_en: Activity by Iteration for Target First Architecture Definition
figures.semantic_review_zh: 目标优先与基线优先的前两轮焦点相反。
figures.labels_connections_zh: 目标行开发1/2/n=Core/Light/Core；基线=Informal/Core/Core；其余规划和治理格与基线优先图一致。
limits_zh: 图不是阶段完成评分，更不表示目标无基线约束。

figures.caption_en: Summary Classification Model for Architecture Landscapes
figures.semantic_review_zh: 战略、分段、能力三级全景在广度、层级、时间三轴展开。
figures.labels_connections_zh: Breadth斜向、Time向右、Level向下；Enterprise Strategic黄色、Segment绿色、Capability紫色叠层。
limits_zh: 叠层图块数量仅示意，无真实能力、项目数量或时间单位。

figures.semantic_review_zh: 架构连续体在通用与特定架构间双向支持复用。
figures.labels_connections_zh: Adaptation for use箭头向右通用→特定；Generalization for future re-use向左特定→通用。
limits_zh: 两个方向不是同时执行的固定工作流；抽象程度不等同三个全景层级。

figures.caption_en: Allocation of Teams to Architecture Scope
figures.semantic_review_zh: 团队拥有范围与跨层协作相结合。
figures.labels_connections_zh: Corporate EA Capability连企业范围，Segment EA Capability连企业/分段；Portfolio Team红框跨分段和能力边界；Project Team连能力层，部分临时项目用虚线连接常设治理。
limits_zh: 图中collaboration不能改成所有权多重性；临时团队实际权限未给；正文Enterprise layer与图Level of Detail用途并存。

figures.semantic_review_zh: 内容可跨架构域、组织范围和细节聚合为愿景及过渡架构。
figures.labels_connections_zh: 横轴Architecture Domains，斜轴Organizational Scope，纵轴Depth of Detail；上方Enterprise/Segment1 Vision，中间Business/Data/Applications/Technology，下方Transition Architectures。
limits_zh: 图不含具体时间轴、实施项目、验收数值；聚合不证明相互语义一致。

tables.caption_en: Table 2-1:  Architecture Engagement Types Area of Engagement Architecture Engagement Description Identification of Required Change Supporting Business Strategy As the business strategies, objectives, goals, and drivers change, it is
tables.semantic_review_zh: 三参与领域下六类架构参与描述。
tables.labels_connections_zh: 战略支持检验影响可行性；全景组合连接运行业绩与需求；项目组合连接范围影响价值；基础性澄清问题；有界详细化已有目标；治理评审、细化与升级。
limits_zh: 架构贡献补充运营/项目管理，未给预算批准权。

source_cells.text_en:
As the business strategies, objectives, goals, and drivers change, it is
necessary for the enterprise to change in order to maintain alignment. The creation of new business strategies can be supported by Enterprise
Architecture by: Providing visibility of change opportunities Providing elaboration on the practical impacts of a particular
strategic choice Providing tests on the feasibility or viability of a particular
strategic direction
Architectural Portfolio Management of the Landscape

It is common practice across large organizations for a service
management organization to provide operational reporting and management
of the IT portfolio. Enterprise Architecture can add a further dimension to service
management reporting, by supporting a linkage between operational
performance and the strategic need for IT. Using the traceability between IT and business inherent in Enterprise
Architecture, it is possible to evaluate the IT portfolio against
operational performance data and business needs (e.g., cost,
functionality, availability, responsiveness) to determine areas where
misalignment is occurring and change needs to take place.

It is common practice across large organizations for a program
management organization to provide operational reporting and management
of the change portfolio. Enterprise Architecture can add a further dimension to project portfolio
management reporting, by supporting a linkage between project scope,
architectural impact, and business value. Architectural factors can be added to other quantitative project factors
to support strategic decision-making on project priority and funding
levels.

Architectural Definition of Foundational Change
Initiatives

Foundational change initiatives are change efforts that have a known
objective, but are not strictly scoped or bounded by a shared vision or
requirements. In foundational change initiatives, the initial priority is to
understand the nature of the problem and to bring structure to the
definition of the problem. Once the problem is more effectively understood, it is possible to
define appropriate solutions and to align stakeholders around a common
vision and purpose.
Architectural Definition of Bounded Change Initiatives

Bounded change initiatives are change efforts that typically arise as
the outcome of a prior architectural strategy, evaluation, or vision. In bounded change initiatives, the desired outcome is already understood
and agreed upon. The focus of architectural effort in this class of
engagement is to effectively elaborate a baseline solution that
addresses the identified requirements, issues, drivers, and constraints.

Once an architectural solution model has been defined, it provides a
basis for design and implementation. In order to ensure that the objectives and value of the defined
architecture are appropriately realized, it is necessary for continuing
Architecture Governance of the implementation process to support design
review, architecture refinement, and issue escalation.

tables.labels_connections_zh: 战略和全景管理基线优先；项目组合聚焦规划治理；基础性为能力/开发基线优先/规划；有界为目标优先/规划；实施为治理。

source_cells.text_en:
Broad, shallow consideration given to the Architecture Landscape in
order to address a specific strategic question and define terms for more
detailed architecture efforts to address strategy realization.
Architectural Portfolio Management of the Landscape

Focus on physical assessment of baseline applications and technology
infrastructure to identify improvement opportunities, typically within
the constraints of maintaining business as usual.

Focus on projects, project dependencies, and landscape impacts to align
project sequencing in a way that is architecturally optimized.
Architectural Definition of Foundational Change Initiatives
Architecture Capability Architecture Development (Baseline First) Transition Planning

Focus on elaborating a vision through definition of baseline and
identifying what needs to change to transition the baseline to the
target.
Architectural Definition of Bounded Change Initiatives

Focus on elaborating the target to meet a previously defined and agreed
vision, scope, or set of constraints. Use the target as a basis for
analysis to avoid perpetuation of baseline, sub-optimal architectures.

Use the Architecture Vision, constraints, principles,
requirements, Target Architecture definition, and transition roadmap to
ensure that projects realize their intended benefit, are aligned with
each other, and are aligned with wider business need.

tables.labels_connections_zh: 开发1先主状态、2另一状态与差距、n细化；规划1临时过渡和初步迁移、n细化反馈；治理1建立人过程技术、n持续复审变更。

This iteration comprises a pass through the Business Architecture,
Information Systems Architecture, and Technology Architecture phases of
the ADM, focusing on definition of the baseline. Opportunities, solutions, and migration plans are also considered to
drive out the focus for change and test feasibility.
Define the Target Architecture and gaps.

This iteration comprises a pass through the Business Architecture,
Information Systems Architecture, and Technology Architecture phases of
the ADM, focusing on definition of the target and analyzing gaps against
the baseline. Opportunities, solutions, and migration plans are also considered to
test viability.

Subsequent
Architecture Development iterations attempt to correct and refine the
target to achieve an outcome that is beneficial, feasible, and viable.

This iteration comprises a pass through the Business Architecture,
Information Systems Architecture, and Technology Architecture phases of
the ADM, focusing on definition of the target. Opportunities, solutions, and migration plans are also considered to
drive out the focus for change and test feasibility.
Define the Baseline Architecture and gaps.

This iteration comprises a pass through the Business Architecture,
Information Systems Architecture, and Technology Architecture phases of
the ADM, focusing on definition of the baseline and analyzing gaps
against the target. Opportunities, solutions, and migration plans are also considered to
test viability.

Subsequent
Architecture Development iterations attempt to correct and refine the
target to achieve an outcome that is beneficial, feasible, and viable.

Define and agree a set of improvement
opportunities, aligned against a provisional Transition Architecture.

The initial iteration of Transition Planning seeks to gain buy-in to a
portfolio of solution opportunities in the Opportunities & Solutions
phase of ADM. This iteration also delivers a provisional Migration Plan.

Agree the Transition Architecture, refining the
identified improvement opportunities to fit.

Subsequent iterations of
Transition Planning seek to refine the Migration Plan, feeding back
issues into the Opportunities & Solutions phase for refinement.

Mobilize Architecture Governance
and change management processes.

The initial Architecture Governance
iteration establishes a process for governance of change and also puts
in place the appropriate people, processes, and technology to support
managed access to and change of the defined architecture.
Carry out Architecture Governance and change control.

Subsequent iterations of the Architecture Governance cycle focus on
periodic reviews of change initiatives to resolve issues and ensure
compliance. Results of a Change Request may trigger another phase to be
revisited; for example, feeding back a new requirement to the
Preliminary Phase to improve the Architecture Capability, or a new
requirement for the architecture into the Architecture Development
phases.

tables.labels_connections_zh: 主题支持运营管理，时间支持发展引入运行退役协调，成熟/波动影响速度和投资，波动场景可适用快速敏捷技术。

source_cells.text_en:
Solutions are naturally organized into groups to support operational
management and control. Examples of solution partitions according to
subject matter would include applications, departments, divisions,
products, services, service centers, sites, etc. Solution decomposition by subject matter is typically the fundamental
technique for structuring both solutions and the architectures that
represent them.

Solution lifecycles are typically organized around a timeline,
which allows the impact of solution development, introduction,
operation, and retirement to be managed against other business activity
occurring in similar time periods.

The maturity and volatility of a solution will typically impact the
speed of execution required for the solution lifecycle. Additionally, volatility and maturity will shape investment priorities.
Solutions existing in highly volatile environments may be better suited
to rapid, agile development techniques.

source_cells.text_en:
The level of detail within an architecture has a strong correlation to
the stakeholder groups that will be interested in the architecture. Typically, less detailed architectures will be of interest to executive
stakeholders. As architectures increase in detail, their relevance to
implementation and operational personnel will also increase.
